title: Soichi Ota Seminar
excerpt: Soichi Ota Seminar is listed for the 2026 academic year. PEARL students are accepted. Double Degree students are not accepted. Language: Japanese only
contentHtml: We are a research group to think about the familiar concept of “work” called “labor economics” together! We are active on Wednesdays during the 4.5 period, and there are no sub-seminars, making it a very fulfilling seminar for university life! This year, we will increase the number of female students! There are no required seminar classes!
